scientific_question: How do advanced cooling technologies change cloud life-cycle impacts?
verified_result: Cold plate and immersion options reduce reported GHG 15-21%, energy 15-20%, and blue-water use 31-52% in the study system.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: No shared municipal reuse pool, incumbent displacement, salt/CoC state, or B0/B1/B2 city-source estimand.

scientific_question: What are US AI-server water and carbon footprints and net-zero pathways?
method_and_scale: US deployment scenarios for 2024-2030 with PUE/WUE, grid, siting, and efficiency uncertainty
verified_result: Annual water footprint estimated at 731-1125 million m3 and additional carbon at 24-44 Mt CO2e across scenarios.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: National footprint projection; no daily urban allocation, reclaimed-water chemistry, or incumbent-user feedback.

access_scope: Abstract plus open-access PMC search extract
scientific_question: Can data centres and WWTPs be paired for water, heat, carbon, and cost benefits?
method_and_scale: Global geodatabase of 4775 data centres and 57547 WWTPs in 98 countries; spatial pairing, engineering optimization, LCA/LCC
verified_result: Headline estimate: about 84 Mt CO2e and 1300 million m3 freshwater saved annually with about US$95.4 billion annual net savings.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: Global attributional pairing does not resolve shared-pool allocation, water-quality competition, or city-source displacement under matched B1/B2.

scientific_question: How much peak water capacity will US data centres require from public systems?
method_and_scale: US direct withdrawal capacity scenarios to 2030 using public sources and water-utility capacity framing
verified_result: Estimated 697-1451 MGD new capacity under persistent 2024 intensity; 227-604 MGD with 10% annual intensity reduction.
overlap_with_ai_uwm: Public-water capacity constraints and peak demand
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: No reclaimed-water chemistry, shared reuse allocation, or solute mass balance.

scientific_question: Where do direct and indirect water impacts move when cooling changes?
method_and_scale: Hourly dispatch, generator-level water consumption, monthly subbasin depletion, Michigan case study
verified_result: Air cooling halves total water relative to evaporative cooling but raises electricity and indirect water consumption by about one-third.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: Grid-generator relocation rather than municipal reclaimed allocation and water-quality feedback.

venue: Water Science & Technology: Water Supply / WaterMet2
scientific_question: How can an urban water system be represented as an integrated metabolism?
method_and_scale: Mass-balance simulation of supply, demand, wastewater, recovery at indoor/local/subcatchment/city scales
verified_result: WaterMet2 quantifies water, energy, GHG, chemical, pollutant, and cost flows across an integrated urban system.
overlap_with_ai_uwm: Urban water-system mass balance and recovery
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: AI cooling chemistry, data-centre counterfactuals, and allocation-quality interaction are outside the original model.

scientific_question: Can desalination and wastewater treatment become maladaptive as adaptation scales?
method_and_scale: Global projections of treatment/desalination capacity, energy, and emissions under scenarios
verified_result: Wastewater treatment and desalination are indispensable but imperfect; energy and emissions depend on system embedding.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: Does not model AI data-centre allocation or daily cooling chemistry.

authors_year: Skerker, Klassert, Francois, Verma, Brown & Fletcher (2026)
scientific_question: How do climate-driven infrastructure and utility decisions affect urban affordability?
method_and_scale: City-scale framework linking climate stress, infrastructure investment, rate design, demand, and household income
verified_result: For Santa Cruz, climate change alone could double bills by mid-century and leave an additional 7-16% of households with unaffordable water.
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: AI cooling/reuse is not the intervention; the paper motivates service-reliability and equity checks beyond facility WUE.

scientific_question: Why should AI cooling sustainability extend beyond water demand?
method_and_scale: Perspective on recirculation, constituent enrichment, water compatibility, treatment demand, and infrastructure
verified_result: Argues that recirculation and reuse shift attention from quantity alone to chemistry, constituent enrichment, and treatment/blowdown management.
overlap_with_ai_uwm: Direct conceptual overlap with the proposed water-chemistry component
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: Does not quantify shared municipal allocation, incumbent potable backfill, or paired B0/B1/B2 city-source effects.

scientific_question: How should data-centre water-use estimates be scoped and evaluated?
method_and_scale: Review of 14 best practices and rubric applied to 31 studies; reports large estimate variance with study design
verified_result: Reports about 24-fold spread in a US case study and recommends stronger scope, representativeness, reproducibility, uncertainty, and terminology practices.
overlap_with_ai_uwm: Measurement and reporting standards for the water-use estimand
missing_or_distinct_mechanism: Review does not simulate city allocation or water-quality process feedback.
